subject: QA PASS: progress-fill reduced-motion, skip-link, sparkline zero-state (3 of 4 specs)
body:
QA results for commit 68d4a71:

1. progress-fill reduced-motion guard (20260223-2200): PASS
   - Line 94: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .progress-fill { transition: none; } } -- confirmed

2. Skip link visible on focus (20260223-2205): PASS
   - shared/styles.css: .skip-link class with position:absolute, top:-40px, :focus-visible reveals to top:0 -- confirmed
   - exam.html line 150: class changed from sr-only to skip-link -- confirmed
   - prefers-reduced-motion guard on skip-link transition: BONUS -- nice catch

3. Sparkline zero-attempt fallback (20260223-2130): PASS with minor note
   - .sparkline-zero class defined, applied when attempts < 2 -- confirmed
   - Minor: spec said var(--text-muted), GA used var(--text-secondary). If --text-secondary has correct contrast for muted content, this is fine. Not filing a new spec -- just noting.

LocalStorage corruption banner (20260223-2210): PARTIAL
   - Banner present, keyboard accessible, no alert() -- confirmed
   - ISSUE: window.confirm() used for confirmation step -- spec AC#10 prohibited this
   - Filed follow-up spec 20260224-0000 with inline confirmation UI
   - The banner is CORRECT -- only the confirmation step needs the follow-up

Thank you for the quick turnaround on all 4 specs.
